questions.text: पहचानिए कि निम्नलिखित में से कौन भारत के भुगतान संतुलन के पूँजी खाते के डेबिट पक्ष में दर्शाया जाएगा ।
questions.text_english: Identify which of the following will appear on the debit side in the Capital Account of India's Balance of Payments.

options.A: इंग्लैंड से एक भारतीय द्वारा प्रेषित धनराशि
options.B: विदेशों में परिसम्पत्ति में भारतीयों द्वारा निवेश
options.C: किसी अमेरिकी कंपनी द्वारा किसी भारतीय कंपनी के अंशों (shares) का क्रय

options_english.A: An Indian sending remittances from England
options_english.B: Investing in assets abroad by Indians
options_english.C: An American company purchasing shares of an Indian company

questions.solution: Investing in assets abroad by Indians leads to an outflow of foreign exchange from India, which is recorded as a debit entry in the Capital Account of the Balance of Payments.

questions.text: पहचानिए कि निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा स्थिर विनिमय दर प्रणाली का एक लाभ नहीं है।
questions.text_english: Identify which of the following is not one of the merits of fixed exchange rate system.

options.A: विनिमय दर में स्थिरता सुनिश्चित करना
options.B: विदेशी मुद्रा के अल्प या अधि-मूल्यांकन की संभावना
options.C: विदेशी मुद्रा बाज़ार में सट्टेबाजी पर रोक लगाना
options.D: समष्टि-अर्थशास्त्रीय नीतियों का समन्वय सुविधाजनक हो जाता है

options_english.A: Ensures stability in exchange rate
options_english.B: Possibility of under or over valuation of foreign currency
options_english.C: Prevents speculations in foreign exchange market
options_english.D: Coordination of macroeconomic policies becomes convenient

questions.solution: The possibility of under or overvaluation of foreign currency is considered a demerit (disadvantage) of a fixed exchange rate system, as it can lead to economic imbalances. The other options listed are recognized advantages of this system.

questions.text:

questions.text_english:
Read the following statements carefully:
Statement 1: A consumption function describes the relationship between consumption and savings.
Statement 2: Consumption function consists of two components autonomous consumption and induced consumption.
questions.instruction_line: दिए गए कथनों के आलोक में, निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.instruction_line_english: In the light of the given statements, choose the correct alternative from the following:

options.A: कथन 1 सत्य है और कथन 2 असत्य है ।
options.B: कथन 1 असत्य है और कथन 2 सत्य है।

options_english.A: Statement 1 is true and Statement 2 is false.
options_english.B: Statement 1 is false and Statement 2 is true.

questions.solution: Statement 1 is false because the consumption function specifically describes the relationship between consumption and income, not consumption and savings. Statement 2 is true as consumption function comprises autonomous and induced consumption.

निम्नलिखित कथनों का ध्यानपूर्वक अध्ययन कीजिए :

कथन 2 : भारत में अमेरिकी दूतावास, भारत के आर्थिक क्षेत्र का हिस्सा है ।

Read the following statements carefully:
Statement 1: Economic territory and political frontier of a nation are one and the same thing.
Statement 2: American Embassy in India is a part of the economic territory of India.

questions.instruction_line_english: In the light of the given statements, choose the correct alternative from the following:

options.A: कथन 1 सत्य है और कथन 2 असत्य है ।
options.B: कथन 1 असत्य है और कथन 2 सत्य है।

options_english.A: Statement 1 is true and statement 2 is false.
options_english.B: Statement 1 is false and statement 2 is true.

questions.solution: Both statements are false. Economic territory is a broader concept than political frontier. Furthermore, the American Embassy in India is considered part of the economic territory of the USA, not India, according to international accounting standards.

questions.text: नकद आरक्षित अनुपात (CRR) के संदर्भ में, असत्य कथन की पहचान कीजिए :
questions.text_english: Identify the incorrect statement with reference to Cash Reserve Ratio (CRR):

options.A: यह माँग व सावधि जमा देनदारियों का एक निश्चित प्रतिशत है, जिसे प्रत्येक बैंक को केन्द्रीय बैंक के पास नकद भंडार (आरक्षित) रूप में रखना होता है ।
options.B: यह केन्द्रीय बैंक द्वारा निर्धारित किया जाता है ।
options.C: यह वाणिज्यिक बैंकों पर बाध्यकारी नहीं होता है ।
options.D: यह केन्द्रीय बैंक द्वारा अर्थव्यवस्था में साख निर्माण को नियंत्रित करने में प्रयुक्त एक उपकरण होता है ।

options_english.A: It is a certain percentage of demand and time deposit liabilities that every bank must keep as cash reserves with the Central Bank.
options_english.B: It is fixed by the Central Bank.
options_english.C: It is not binding on the commercial banks.
options_english.D: It is a tool used by the Central Bank to control the credit creation in the economy.

questions.solution: Statement C is incorrect because CRR is indeed binding on all commercial banks as per the central bank's regulations. The other statements accurately describe CRR.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित चित्र का ध्यानपूर्वक अध्ययन कीजिए तथा रिक्त स्थान की पूर्ति के लिए सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए : [Image Description: A tree diagram shows Balance of Payments Account splitting into Current Account and Capital Account. Under Current Account, three branches are shown: 'Trade in merchandise', '-------', and 'Transfer Payments'.]

Under Current Account, three branches are shown: 'Trade in merchandise', '-------', and 'Transfer Payments'.]

options.A: निवेश
options.B: सेवाओं का व्यापार

options_english.A: Investments
options_english.B: Trade of Services

questions.solution: The standard components of the Current Account in the Balance of Payments are Trade in merchandise (visible items), Trade in services (invisible items), and Unilateral transfer payments. Therefore, 'Trade of Services' is the correct missing component.

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित कथनों का ध्यानपूर्वक अध्ययन कीजिए :
कथन 1 : मुद्रा वह वस्तु है, जिसे साधारणतया विनिमय के माध्यम के रूप में स्वीकार किया जाता है ।
कथन 2 : मुद्रा ने आवश्यकताओं के दोहरे संयोग की समस्या को हल किया था ।
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements carefully:
Statement 1: Money is a commodity which is generally accepted as a medium of exchange.
Statement 2: Money solved the problem of double coincidence of wants.
questions.instruction_line: दिए गए कथनों के आलोक में, निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.instruction_line_english: In the light of the given statements, choose the correct alternative from the following:

options.A: कथन 1 सत्य है और कथन 2 असत्य है।
options.B: कथन 1 असत्य है और कथन 2 सत्य है।

options_english.A: Statement 1 is true and statement 2 is false.
options_english.B: Statement 1 is false and statement 2 is true.

questions.solution: Both statements are correct. Money functions as a medium of exchange, and its introduction eliminated the complex requirement of double coincidence of wants found in the barter system.

questions.text: मान लीजिए कि एक काल्पनिक अर्थव्यवस्था में, स्वायत्त उपभोग = ₹500 करोड़ तथा सीमांत उपभोग प्रवृत्ति = 0.8 है । तो अर्थव्यवस्था के लिए बचत फलन _______ होगा । (रिक्त स्थान भरने के लिए सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए)
questions.text_english: Suppose in an imaginary economy, autonomous consumption = ₹500 crore and marginal propensity to consume = 0.8. The saving function for the economy would be ***. (Choose the correct alternative to fill in the blank)
questions.solution: The saving function is S = -C0 + (1-MPC)Y. Given autonomous consumption (C0) = 500, then -C0 = -500. Given MPC = 0.8, then MPS = 1 - 0.8 = 0.2. Thus, the saving function is S = -500 + 0.2Y.

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित कथनों को पढ़िए: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) । नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों में से सही विकल्प चुनिए :
अभिकथन (A) : आय का संतुलन स्तर तब निर्धारित होता है, जब प्रत्याशित व्यय व प्रत्याशित उत्पादन एक-दूसरे के बराबर होते हैं ।
कारण (R) : आय का संतुलन स्तर, उत्पादन के पूर्ण रोज़गार स्तर के समान या असमान हो सकता है ।
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements: Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Choose the correct alternative from those given below :
Assertion (A): The equilibrium level of income is determined, when ex-ante spending and ex-ante output are equal.
Reason (R): The equilibrium level of income may or may not be the same as the full employment level of output.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं और कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है ।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं, लेकिन कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है ।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सत्य है, लेकिन कारण (R) असत्य है ।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) असत्य है, लेकिन कारण (R) सत्य है ।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Both statements are true. Equilibrium income is determined where ex-ante aggregate demand equals ex-ante aggregate output. The equilibrium level can indeed be at, below, or above full employment. However, Reason (R) does not explain why the equality of ex-ante spending and output determines equilibrium, hence it is not the correct explanation for (A).

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित कथनों का अध्ययन कीजिए अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) । नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों में से सही विकल्प चुनिए :
अभिकथन (A) : सीमांत बचत प्रवृत्ति (MPS) का अधिकतम मूल्य इकाई हो सकता है ।
कारण (R) : आय के समस्तर पर, बचत शून्य होती हैं ।
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements: Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Choose the correct alternative from those given below :
Assertion (A): The maximum value of Marginal Propensity to Save (MPS) can be unity.
Reason (R): At the break-even level of income, savings are zero.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं और कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है ।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं, लेकिन कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है ।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सत्य है, लेकिन कारण (R) असत्य है ।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) असत्य है, लेकिन कारण (R) असत्य है ।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Both statements are true. MPS is a fraction of change in income saved, with a maximum value of 1. Break-even level of income refers to where saving is zero. However, Reason (R) provides no explanation for why the maximum value of MPS is unity.

questions.text:
(क) "भुगतान संतुलन खाते में स्थिरता बनाए रखने के लिए समायोजनकारी लेनदेन किए जाते हैं।" वैध स्पष्टीकरण के साथ दिए गए कथन की पुष्टि कीजिए।

अथवा

(ख) "मुद्रा का मूल्यह्रास किसी राष्ट्र के निर्यात को प्रोत्साहित कर सकता है।" मान्य तर्कों के साथ दिए गए कथन का समर्थन या खंडन कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) "Accommodating transactions are undertaken to maintain stability in the Balance of Payments Account." Justify the given statement with valid explanation.

OR

(b) "Depreciation of currency may promote exports of a nation." Defend or refute the given statement with valid arguments.

key_points: Accommodating transactions are those undertaken to cover the deficit or surplus in the BoP account, specifically focusing on maintaining autonomous stability.
They are independent of profit motives and are carried out by monetary authorities.
Depreciation of domestic currency makes exports cheaper in the international market, thus increasing the competitive demand for domestic goods abroad.

questions.solution: Accommodating transactions are indeed undertaken to maintain stability in the Balance of Payments (BoP) account. These transactions are executed by the monetary authorities to balance out the net deficit or surplus resulting from autonomous transactions, ensuring the BoP identity holds. Alternatively, currency depreciation makes domestic goods relatively cheaper for foreign buyers because the domestic currency now has lower value in terms of foreign exchange. This increased price competitiveness stimulates demand for exports, thus promoting them.

questions.text:
नीचे दिए गए आँकड़ों के आधार पर, साधन लागत पर सकल राष्ट्रीय उत्पाद (GNPFC) के मूल्य का आकलन कीजिए :
(i) मज़दूरी व वेतन: 2,000
(ii) किराया व ब्याज: 800
(iii) निगम कर: 500
(iv) अवितरित लाभ: 300
(v) लाभांश: 200
(vi) मूल्यह्रास: 150
(vii) विदेशों से प्राप्त शुद्ध साधन आय: (-) 50
questions.text_english:
On the basis of the data given below, estimate the value of Gross National Product at Factor Cost (GNPFC):
(i) Wages and Salaries: 2,000
(ii) Rent and Interest: 800
(iii) Corporate Tax: 500
(iv) Undistributed Profit: 300
(v) Dividend: 200
(vi) Depreciation: 150
(vii) Net factor income from abroad: (-) 50

key_points: NDPfc = Wages & Salaries + Rent & Interest + Corporate Tax + Undistributed Profit + Dividend = 2000 + 800 + 500 + 300 + 200 = 3800
GNPfc = NDPfc + Depreciation + Net Factor Income from Abroad = 3800 + 150 + (-50) = 3900

questions.solution: To calculate GNPfc, we first calculate Net Domestic Product at Factor Cost (NDPfc) using the income method: Wages & Salaries (2000) + Rent & Interest (800) + Corporate Tax (500) + Undistributed Profit (300) + Dividend (200) = 3800. Then, GNPfc = NDPfc + Depreciation + Net Factor Income from Abroad = 3800 + 150 - 50 = 3900 crore.

questions.text:
(क) "यदि पूर्ण रोज़गार स्तर पर, अंतिम वस्तुओं की वास्तविक माँग अंतिम वस्तुओं के वास्तविक उत्पादन से कम हो, तो इससे मालसूची (Inventory) का अनपेक्षित संचय हो सकता है।" क्या आप दिए गए कथन से सहमत हैं? अपने उत्तर के समर्थन में मान्य कारण दीजिए।

अथवा

(ख) निम्नलिखित तालिका को पूरा कीजिए। आय के ₹200 करोड़ के स्तर पर उपभोग फलन का निर्माण कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) "If actual demand for final goods falls short of the actual output of final goods corresponding to the full employment level, it may lead to an unintended accumulation of inventories." Do you agree with the given statement? Give valid reasons in support of your answer.

OR

(b) Complete the following table. Construct the consumption function at the ₹200 crore level of income.

key_points: Agree. When aggregate demand (AD) < aggregate supply (AS), producers face unsold inventory.
This leads to an unintended accumulation of stocks as demand is less than planned production.

sub_questions.solution: I agree with the statement. When actual aggregate demand falls short of aggregate supply, the goods produced remain unsold, leading to an unplanned or unintended accumulation of inventories. Consequently, producers tend to cut production in the next cycle, which reduces output and employment.

questions.solution: For part (a), the answer is provided in the sub_questions. For part (b), filling the table using standard income, consumption, and savings relations requires calculating consumption (C = Y - S). At Y=200, given APC = 0.75, C = 150. S = Y - C = 50. Consumption function C = C0 + bY.

questions.text: "वाणिज्यिक बैंकों की साख निर्माण क्षमता में वृद्धि का अर्थव्यवस्था में मुद्रा आपूर्ति पर प्रत्यक्ष प्रभाव पड़ता है।" दिए गए कथन पर चर्चा कीजिए।
questions.text_english: "An increase in the credit creation capacity of commercial banks has a direct impact on the money supply in an economy." Discuss the given statement.

key_points: Money supply is linked to credit creation by commercial banks.
Higher lending increases deposits, which expands money supply via the multiplier process.
The central bank controls this through SLR, CRR, and Repo rate.

questions.solution: Commercial banks expand money supply through the credit creation process. When banks lend, they create demand deposits, which function as money. The extent of credit creation depends on the Cash Reserve Ratio (CRR) and Statutory Liquidity Ratio (SLR). A higher capacity for credit creation directly increases the total volume of money circulating in the economy. Conversely, if the central bank increases reserve requirements, the banks' ability to lend decreases, thus contracting the money supply.

questions.text: एक काल्पनिक अर्थव्यवस्था के लिए, यह मान लीजिए कि सरकार ₹ 30,000 करोड़ का बुनियादी ढाँचागत निवेश करेगी । अर्थव्यवस्था में अतिरिक्त आय का 80% उपभोग होता है । अर्थव्यवस्था में आय में वृद्धि तथा उसके अनुरूप उपभोग व्यय में वृद्धि का आकलन कीजिए ।
questions.text_english: For a hypothetical economy, assume the government increased an infrastructural investment by 30,000 crore. 80% of additional income is consumed in the economy. Estimate the increase in income and the corresponding increase in consumption expenditure in the economy.

key_points: Investment Multiplier (k) = 1 / (1 - MPC) = 1 / (1 - 0.8) = 1 / 0.2 = 5.
Increase in Income (ΔY) = k * ΔI = 5 * 30,000 = 1,50,000 crore.
Increase in Consumption (ΔC) = MPC * ΔY = 0.8 * 1,50,000 = 1,20,000 crore.

questions.solution: Given the investment (ΔI) is ₹30,000 crore and MPC is 0.8, the investment multiplier (k) = 1 / (1 - 0.8) = 1 / 0.2 = 5. The total increase in income (ΔY) is k * ΔI = 5 * 30,000 = ₹1,50,000 crore. The increase in consumption expenditure (ΔC) is MPC * ΔY = 0.8 * 1,50,000 = ₹1,20,000 crore.

questions.text:
(क) (i) सोदाहरण प्रत्यक्ष कर व अप्रत्यक्ष कर के मध्य अंतर स्पष्ट कीजिए । (ii) सरकारी बजट के 'संसाधनों के पुनः आबंटन' उद्देश्य की व्याख्या कीजिए ।
अथवा
(ख) (i) मान लीजिए कि एक काल्पनिक अर्थव्यवस्था के लिए निम्नलिखित आँकड़े प्रस्तुत किए गए हैं: [Data Table Provided] राजस्व घाटे व राजकोषीय घाटे की गणना कीजिए । (ii) सार्वजनिक प्रावधान तथा सार्वजनिक उत्पादन में अन्तर स्पष्ट कीजिए ।
questions.text_english:
(a) (i) Distinguish between direct tax and indirect tax with the help of suitable examples. (ii) Explain the 'reallocation of resources' objective of Government Budget.
OR
(b) (i) Suppose the following data is presented for an imaginary economy: [Data Table Provided] Calculate Revenue Deficit and Fiscal Deficit. (ii) Differentiate between public provision and public production.

sub_questions.text: प्रत्यक्ष कर व अप्रत्यक्ष कर में अंतर
sub_questions.text_english: Difference between direct and indirect tax

key_points: Direct tax: Burden cannot be shifted (e.g., Income Tax).
Indirect tax: Burden can be shifted (e.g., GST).

sub_questions.solution: Direct taxes are taxes whose burden cannot be shifted to others, such as Income Tax. Conversely, the burden of indirect taxes can be shifted to another person, as seen in the case of Goods and Services Tax (GST).

sub_questions.text: संसाधनों के पुनः आबंटन का उद्देश्य

key_points: Govt uses taxes and subsidies to influence resource allocation.
Discourages harmful goods (high taxes) and encourages socially beneficial goods (subsidies).

sub_questions.solution: The government uses budgetary policies, including taxes and subsidies, to reallocate resources in the economy. Taxes are imposed on harmful goods to discourage consumption, while subsidies are offered for essential or socially beneficial goods to encourage their production and use.

questions.solution: For part (a), the answers are provided in the sub_questions. For part (b), Revenue Deficit = Revenue Expenditure - Revenue Receipts. Fiscal Deficit = Total Expenditure - Total Receipts (excluding borrowings). Public provision implies financing through the budget, whereas public production involves the state actually producing the goods.

questions.text:
उत्पादन प्रक्रिया में उत्पादन के साधनों द्वारा लिए गए निर्णय प्रायः हितधारकों को अप्रत्यक्ष रूप से प्रभावित कर सकते हैं । इस प्रकार के प्रभाव कई बार अत्यंत व्यापक होते हैं परन्तु राष्ट्रीय आय का आकलन करते समय इन्हें ध्यान में नहीं रखा जाता है । अर्थशास्त्री इन्हें बाह्यताएँ कहते हैं तथा ये बाह्यताएँ सकारात्मक अथवा नकारात्मक हो सकती हैं ।

इस संबंध में, कई अर्थशास्त्री पारिस्थितिक संतुलन सुनिश्चित करने के लिए कार्बन मूल्य-निर्धारण को एक महत्त्वपूर्ण उपकरण के रूप में उपयोग करने का सुझाव देते हैं ।

कार्बन मूल्य-निर्धारण या तो उत्सर्जन पर शुल्क लगाकर या कम उत्सर्जन पर सब्सिडी देकर ग्रीनहाउस गैस उत्सर्जन को नियंत्रित करने की कोशिश करता है । कार्बन कर, ग्रीन सेस, इको टैक्स, आदि जैसे साधनों के माध्यम से अर्थशास्त्री इस प्रकार की नकारात्मक बाह्यताओं को समाप्त करने वाली हरित तकनीक की ओर अग्रसर होने का सुझाव देते हैं ।
questions.text_english:
Decisions taken by factors of production in the production process often may affect the stakeholders indirectly. Such impacts at times are huge but are not accounted for, while estimating national income. Economists call them as externalities and they can be positive or negative.

In this regard, many economists suggest carbon pricing as an important tool to ensure ecological balance.

Carbon pricing tries to control greenhouse gas emissions by either placing a fee on emitting or offering subsidies on lesser emission. Through instruments like carbon tax, green cess, eco tax, etc. economists suggest moving towards greener technology eliminating such negative externalities.
questions.instruction_line: दिए गए गद्य तथा सामान्य समझ के आधार पर, निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए :
questions.instruction_line_english: On the basis of the given text and common understanding, answer the following questions :

key_points: Externalities are indirect effects of production or consumption decisions on third parties that are not accounted for in market prices.

sub_questions.solution: Externalities are the indirect effects of production or consumption activities on third parties for which no compensation is paid or received, and these effects are not reflected in national income estimates.

sub_questions.text: सकारात्मक व नकारात्मक बाह्यताओं के मध्य अंतर स्पष्ट कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: Differentiate between positive and negative externalities.

key_points: Positive: Beneficial effects on others (e.g., vaccination).
Negative: Harmful effects on others (e.g., pollution).

sub_questions.solution: Positive externalities occur when an economic activity provides benefits to third parties, such as the social benefit of vaccination programs. Negative externalities refer to harmful impacts on third parties, such as pollution generated by a manufacturing firm.

sub_questions.text: विस्तार से बताइए कि कार्बन मूल्य निर्धारण को कैसे व क्यों प्रोत्साहित किया जाना चाहिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: Elaborate how and why carbon pricing should be promoted.

key_points: Why: To maintain ecological balance and mitigate climate change by addressing negative externalities.
How: By implementing instruments like carbon tax, green cess, or eco-taxes to incentivize greener technology.

sub_questions.solution: Carbon pricing should be promoted to ensure ecological balance by curbing greenhouse gas emissions. It is necessary because greenhouse emissions are negative externalities that harm society. It should be implemented through financial tools like carbon taxes, green cesses, or eco-taxes, which discourage high-emission activities and incentivize the adoption of cleaner, greener technologies.

questions.solution: The passage highlights externalities as uncounted impacts of production on stakeholders. Carbon pricing addresses negative externalities to protect ecological balance.

questions.text: *** के कारण चीन अपनी तीव्र जनसंख्या वृद्धि दर को नियंत्रित करने में सक्षम हुआ था । (रिक्त स्थान भरने के लिए सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए)
questions.text_english: China was able to control its rapid population growth rate owing to _______. (Choose the correct alternative to fill in the blank)

options.A: आर्थिक सुधार
options.B: एकल शिशु नीति

options_english.A: Economic reforms
options_english.B: One-Child Policy

questions.solution: China implemented the One-Child Policy in the late 1970s to drastically reduce its rapid population growth rate.
questions.chapter: Comparative Development Experiences of India and its Neighbours

questions.text: ब्रिटिश शासन के दौरान, भारत के विदेशी व्यापार में _______ को छोड़कर कई विशेषताएँ थीं । (रिक्त स्थान भरने के लिए सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए)
questions.text_english: During the British rule, India's foreign trade had various features except _______. (Choose the correct alternative to fill in the blank)

options.A: वस्तु उत्पादन, व्यापार व प्रशुल्क की प्रतिबंधात्मक नीतियों
options.B: भारत के निर्यात व आयात पर ब्रिटिश एकाधिकार
options.C: भारत से शेष विश्व के लिए मुक्त व्यापार

options_english.A: Restrictive policies of commodity production, trade and tariff
options_english.B: British monopoly over India's exports and imports
options_english.C: Free trade from India to the rest of the world

questions.solution: During British rule, India did not have 'free trade' with the rest of the world. Instead, its trade was heavily restricted and oriented specifically to serve British interests, ensuring monopoly and control.
questions.chapter: Indian Economy on the Eve of Independence

questions.text:
आधुनिकीकरण एक महत्त्वपूर्ण आर्थिक नियोजन उद्देश्य है, जो _______ पर केन्द्रित है । (रिक्त स्थान भरने के लिए सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए)
(i) नवीन प्रौद्योगिकी को अपनाने
(ii) आय व संपत्ति के समान वितरण
(iii) सामाजिक दृष्टिकोण में सकारात्मक परिवर्तन लाने
questions.text_english:
Modernization is an important economic planning objective that focuses on ***. (Choose the correct alternative to fill in the blank)
(i) Adoption of innovative technology
(ii) Equal distribution of income and wealth
(iii) Bringing positive changes in the social outlook

options.A: केवल (i)
options.B: (i) और (ii)

options_english.A: Only (i)
options_english.B: (i) and (ii)

questions.solution: Modernization in the context of India's economic planning refers to the adoption of new technology and bringing about positive changes in the social outlook (like gender equality). Equal distribution of income/wealth is a separate objective of planning (Equity), not modernization.

questions.text: *** खेती एक ऐसी प्रणाली है, जो पारिस्थितिक संतुलन को पुनर्स्थापित करने, बनाए रखने व वृद्धि करने में सहायक होती है । (रिक्त स्थान भरने के लिए सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए)
questions.text_english: ******* farming is a system that is helpful in restoring, maintaining and enhancing the ecological balance. (Choose the correct alternative to fill in the blank)

options.A: पारंपरिक
options.B: जैविक

options_english.A: Conventional
options_english.B: Organic

questions.solution: Organic farming is defined by its focus on sustainability and enhancing the ecological balance by avoiding harmful chemicals.

questions.text:
चीन में वर्तमान तीव्र औद्योगिक विकास की जड़ें 1978 में लागू किए गए आर्थिक सुधारों में खोजी जा सकती हैं, जहाँ (रिक्त स्थान भरने के लिए सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए):
(i) प्रारंभ में कृषि, विदेशी व्यापार व निवेश क्षेत्रों में सुधार शुरू किए गए थे
(ii) दोहरे मूल्य-निर्धारण की नीति अपनाई गई थी
(iii) सरकार ने विशेष आर्थिक क्षेत्र की नीति को रद्द कर दिया था
questions.text_english:
The present day rapid industrial growth in China can be traced back to the economic reforms introduced in 1978, where (Choose the correct alternative to fill in the blank):
(i) initially reforms were initiated in agriculture, foreign trade and investment sectors
(ii) the policy of dual pricing was adopted
(iii) the Government revoked the policy of Special Economic Zones

options.A: केवल (i)
options.B: केवल (ii)

options_english.A: Only (i)
options_english.B: Only (ii)

questions.solution: Reforms in China (1978) started with agriculture, trade, and investment. Dual pricing was part of the reform strategy. The government did not revoke, but instead actively established and utilized Special Economic Zones (SEZs) to drive development, making statement (iii) incorrect.
questions.chapter: Comparative Development Experiences of India and its Neighbours

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित कथनों को पढ़िए: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) । नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों में से सही विकल्प चुनिए :
अभिकथन (A) : हाल के दिनों में, भारतीय अर्थव्यवस्था रोज़गारहीन संवृद्धि की समस्या का सामना कर रही है।
कारण (R) : रोज़गारहीन संवृद्धि से तात्पर्य है, एक ऐसी स्थिति जहाँ एक अर्थव्यवस्था अतिरिक्त रोज़गार उत्पन्न किए बिना अधिक वस्तुओं और सेवाओं का उत्पादन करने में सक्षम हो ।
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements: Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Choose the correct alternative from those given below :
Assertion (A): In the recent past, Indian economy has been facing the problem of jobless growth.
Reason (R): Jobless growth refers to a situation where an economy is able to produce more goods and services without generating additional employment.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं और कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है ।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं, लेकिन कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है ।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सत्य है, लेकिन कारण (R) असत्य है ।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) असत्य है, लेकिन कारण (R) सत्य है ।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Both statements are true, and the definition in Reason (R) correctly describes the concept of jobless growth as stated in Assertion (A).

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित कथनों का ध्यानपूर्वक अध्ययन कीजिए :
कथन 1 : भारत, पाकिस्तान व चीन की भौतिक खाद्यान्न संपन्नताओं में तो काफी समानताएँ है, परन्तु उनकी राजनीतिक व्यवस्थाएँ बिल्कुल भिन्न हैं ।
कथन 2 : भारत व पाकिस्तान दोनों ने एक बड़ा निजी क्षेत्र विकसित करने पर अधिक बल दिया था ।
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements carefully:
Statement 1: India, Pakistan and China have similar physical endowments, but totally different political systems.
Statement 2: Both India and Pakistan laid great emphasis on creating a large private sector.
questions.instruction_line: दिए गए कथनों के आलोक में, निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.instruction_line_english: In the light of the given statements, choose the correct alternative from the following:

options.A: कथन 1 सत्य है और कथन 2 असत्य है ।
options.B: कथन 1 असत्य है और कथन 2 सत्य है।

options_english.A: Statement 1 is true and Statement 2 is false.
options_english.B: Statement 1 is false and Statement 2 is true.

questions.solution: Both statements are historically correct in the context of their development experiences. China had a communist system (later reforming), while India and Pakistan both operated mixed economies with significant roles for the private sector.
questions.chapter: Comparative Development Experiences of India and its Neighbours

questions.text: मानव पूँजी निर्माण के स्रोतों की पहचान कीजिए व रिक्त स्थान भरने के लिए सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए । [Image Description: A radial diagram centered on 'Sources of Human Capital Formation' with branches: 'Expenditure on Education', 'Expenditure on Information', 'Expenditure on On-the-job Training', and two unnamed blanks.]

[Image Description: A radial diagram centered on 'Sources of Human Capital Formation' with branches: 'Expenditure on Education', 'Expenditure on Information', 'Expenditure on On-the-job Training', and two unnamed blanks.]

options.A: स्वास्थ्य पर व्यय व विद्यालयों पर व्यय
options.B: तकनीक पर व्यय व ज्ञान पर व्यय
options.C: प्रवासन पर व्यय व ज्ञान पर व्यय
options.D: स्वास्थ्य पर व्यय व प्रवासन पर व्यय

questions.solution: The standard five sources of Human Capital Formation are Expenditure on Education, Health, Information, On-the-job training, and Migration. The options given in D correspond to the missing categories.

questions.text:
कॉलम I में दिए गए श्रमिकों के प्रकार से कॉलम II में दिए गए कार्य की प्रकृति की सही पहचान कीजिए :
कॉलम I: 1. सीमेंट की दुकान का मालिक, 2. निर्माण मज़दूर, 3. सिविल अभियंता
कॉलम II: (i) नियमित वेतनभोगी, (ii) आकस्मिक दिहाड़ी मज़दूरी, (iii) स्व-नियोजित
questions.text_english:
From the type of workers given in Column I, identify the correct nature of work in Column II:
Column I: 1. Cement shop owner, 2. Construction worker, 3. Civil engineer
Column II: (i) Regular salaried, (ii) Casual wage workers, (iii) Self-employed
questions.solution: A cement shop owner is self-employed (1-iii), a construction worker is a casual wage worker (2-ii), and a civil engineer (in a standard job context) is a regular salaried worker (3-i).

questions.text:
आर्थिक सुधारों को लागू करने के उपरांत, पाकिस्तान ने _______ कारणों से विकास में मंदी का अनुभव किया है । (रिक्त स्थान भरने के लिए सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए)
(i) कृषि क्षेत्र का अस्थिर प्रदर्शन

questions.text_english:
After the implementation of economic reforms, Pakistan experienced slowdown of growth due to various reasons including (Choose the correct alternative to fill in the blank)
(i) Volatile performance of the agriculture sector
(ii) Over-dependence on remittances from abroad
(iii) Political instability

options.A: (i) और (ii)
options.B: (ii) और (iii)

options_english.A: (i) and (ii)
options_english.B: (ii) and (iii)

questions.solution: Pakistan's growth post-reforms has been hindered by agricultural volatility, reliance on remittances, and significant political instability. All three factors contributed.
questions.chapter: Comparative Development Experiences of India and its Neighbours

questions.text:
(क) "अतिलघु-साख (सूक्ष्म ऋण) कार्यक्रमों ने औपचारिक ऋण प्रणाली में अंतर को भरने में सहायता की है।" दिए गए कथन की पुष्टि कीजिए।

अथवा

(ख) "सूचना प्रौद्योगिकी ग्रामीण विकास में महत्त्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभा सकती है।" दिए गए कथन पर संक्षेप में चर्चा कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) "Micro-credit programmes have helped to fill in the gaps in the formal credit system." Justify the given statement.

OR

(b) "Information Technology can play a crucial role in rural development." Discuss briefly the given statement.

key_points: Micro-credit offers loans to those without collateral, filling the void left by formal banks.
IT provides farmers with market price data, better agricultural techniques, and access to services.

questions.solution: Micro-credit programmes reach marginalized sections who lack the collateral required by formal banks, thereby bridging the access gap to credit and promoting self-employment. Alternatively, Information Technology (IT) empowers rural areas by providing timely information on market prices, weather forecasts, and modern agricultural practices, which enhances productivity and reduces information asymmetry in rural markets.

questions.text: दिए गए चित्र की व्याख्या कीजिए तथा इसे पारिस्थितिक आपदा बनने से रोकने के लिए किसी एक रणनीति की व्याख्या कीजिए । [Image Description: A picture of an industrial area with smoking chimneys and heavy smoke pollution over factories.]
questions.text_english: Interpret the given picture and explain any one strategy to control it from becoming an ecological disaster. [Image Description: A picture of an industrial area with smoking chimneys and heavy smoke pollution over factories.]

key_points: Picture shows air pollution due to industrial emissions.
Strategy: Adoption of cleaner technology or filters on chimneys.

questions.solution: The image depicts a high degree of industrial air pollution, which is a major environmental hazard. To prevent it from becoming an ecological disaster, industries should be mandated to adopt greener, cleaner technologies, and install pollution control devices like filters and scrubbers on smokestacks to reduce toxic emissions.

questions.text: मानव पूँजी निर्माण से होने वाले किन्हीं दो लाभों की चर्चा कीजिए ।
questions.text_english: Discuss any two benefits accruing from human capital formation.

key_points: Increases productivity and efficiency of workforce.
Promotes innovation and faster economic growth.

questions.solution: The two primary benefits of human capital formation are: firstly, it significantly increases the productivity and efficiency of the workforce, leading to higher output; secondly, a better-educated and healthy workforce promotes innovation and technological adaptation, which in turn fosters faster and sustainable economic growth.

questions.text: नीचे दिए गए आँकड़ों के आधार पर, भारत व चीन में उत्पादन व रोज़गार के क्षेत्रवार परिवर्तनों की चर्चा कीजिए : [Table Provided: GVA and Workforce share for Agriculture, Industry, Services]
questions.text_english: On the basis of the data given below, discuss the shift in output and employment sector-wise, in India and China : [Table Provided: GVA and Workforce share for Agriculture, Industry, Services]

key_points: India has a large share of workforce in agriculture but lower GVA contribution.
China has moved its workforce significantly towards industry and services compared to India.
Both countries show services as the dominant sector for GVA.

questions.solution: The data indicates that India still retains a large portion of its workforce in the agricultural sector (43%) despite its relatively low contribution to the Gross Value Added (GVA) (16%). In contrast, China has successfully transitioned a greater percentage of its workforce into the industry and service sectors. While both nations derive a significant portion of their GVA from the service sector, the structural transformation of employment in China is more advanced than in India.

अथवा
(ख) 1991 के आर्थिक सुधारों के दौरान सरकार द्वारा प्रारंभ किए गए कर व्यवस्था में सुधार से संबंधित किन्हीं दो उदारीकरण उपायों पर चर्चा कीजिए ।
questions.text_english:
(a) Discuss any two factors that lead to stagnating Indian agriculture sector during British rule.
OR
(b) Discuss any two liberalization measures pertaining to the tax reforms, introduced by the government, during the economic reform process of 1991.

key_points: Factors of stagnation: Zamindari system (landlord exploitation) and lack of investment in irrigation/infrastructure.
Tax reforms: Rationalization of tax structure and reduction in direct and indirect tax rates.

questions.solution: For part (a), two key factors were: first, the land tenure system (specifically Zamindari), which prioritized rent collection over agricultural development; second, the lack of government investment in irrigation, flood control, and other necessary infrastructure. For part (b), two key measures were: first, the simplification and rationalization of the tax structure to improve compliance; second, the significant reduction in corporate and personal income tax rates to incentivize growth and investment.
questions.chapter: Indian Economy on the Eve of Independence / Economic Reforms since 1991

questions.text_english:
(a) (i) "Amita is a regular worker in a private firm that employs twelve hired workers." Is she working in the formal or informal sector? Give valid reasons in support of your answer.
(ii) State any two sources of data on unemployment in India.
(iii) Elaborate the need to promote women's education in India.

OR

(b) (i) "The participation rate of people in economic activities in rural areas is more than that in urban areas." Justify the given statement.
(ii) Define disguised unemployment. State its implications on output and employment in a country.

key_points: Likely informal sector as it only has 12 workers.
Formal sector usually requires 10+ employees, but typically implies wider social security/compliance coverage.

sub_questions.solution: Amita is likely working in the informal sector. Even though the firm has 12 workers (crossing the threshold for some formal registrations), the informal sector is generally characterized by a lack of social security benefits and non-compliance with labor laws, which is common in small private firms regardless of employment size.

key_points: NSSO Reports
Annual Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS)

sub_questions.solution: Two main sources of unemployment data in India are reports from the National Sample Survey Office (NSSO) and the Annual Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS) by the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation.

key_points: Better social status and empowerment.
Improvement in health/literacy outcomes of next generation.
Increased workforce participation.

sub_questions.solution: Promoting women's education in India is essential for empowerment and reducing gender inequality. Educated women contribute significantly to economic output, participate more in the workforce, and improve the health and literacy outcomes of future generations, ultimately leading to higher overall societal productivity.

questions.solution: For part (a), the answers are in the sub_questions. For part (b), (i) Rural areas have higher participation due to agricultural needs where many work as unpaid family labour. (ii) Disguised unemployment occurs when more people are employed than required, resulting in zero marginal productivity of additional workers, hence wasting potential labour.

questions.text:
स्वतंत्रता उपरांत भारत की औद्योगिक नीति को मुख्यतः 1948 के औद्योगिक नीति संकल्प के संदर्भ में आकार दिया गया था। इसमें राष्ट्रीय हित में उद्योगों के विकास को प्रोत्साहन देने, सहायता करने व विनियमित करने के मामले में सरकार की पूर्ण जिम्मेदारी पर बल दिया गया था। इसमें सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र के लिए एक सक्रिय व प्रमुख भूमिका की परिकल्पना की गई थी。

अगला औद्योगिक नीति संकल्प 30 अप्रैल, 1956 को प्रधान मंत्री द्वारा संसद के समक्ष रखा गया था। इस संकल्प ने सुझाव दिया था कि, "राष्ट्रीय उद्देश्य के रूप में अर्थव्यवस्था के समाजवादी ढाँचे को अपनाने के साथ-साथ योजनाबद्ध व तीव्र विकास की आवश्यकता है। इसके लिए यह आवश्यक है कि बुनियादी व सामरिक महत्त्व के सभी उद्योग अथवा सार्वजनिक उपयोगी सेवाएँ सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र के अधीन होने चाहिए।

अन्य उद्योग जो अति आवश्यक हैं तथा जिनमें बड़े पैमाने पर निवेश की आवश्यकता होती है (जो केवल राज्य ही प्रदान कर सकता है), उन्हें भी सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र के अधीन होना चाहिए। इसलिए राज्य को उद्योगों के भावी विकास के लिए प्रत्यक्ष उत्तरदायित्व ग्रहण करना होगा।"

यह संकल्प उद्योगों को तीन श्रेणियों में वर्गीकृत करता है:
• अनुसूची A में दी गई पहली श्रेणी में ऐसे उद्योग शामिल हैं, जिनका भविष्य में विकास राज्य की विशेष जिम्मेदारी होगी।
• दूसरी श्रेणी में, अनुसूची B में वे उद्योग दिए गए हैं जो उत्तरोत्तर राज्य के स्वामित्व वाले होंगे। हालाँकि, इनमें निजी उद्यम से भी भागीदारी की उम्मीद की जाएगी।
• तीसरी श्रेणी में शेष सभी उद्योगों को शामिल किया गया है, जिनका आगे का विकास निजी क्षेत्र की पहल व उद्यम पर निर्भर होगा।
questions.text_english:
India's industrial policy since independence has been shaped broadly in terms of the Industrial Policy Resolution of 1948. It emphasized the sole responsibility of the government in promoting, assisting and regulating the development of industries in the national interest. It envisaged an active and dominant role for the public sector.

The next Industrial Policy Resolution was placed before Parliament by the Prime Minister on 30 April 1956. It suggested that, "There is a need for adoption of the socialist pattern of economy as the national objective, along with the need for planned and rapid development. It required that all industries of basic and strategic importance, or in public utility services, should be in the public sector.

Other industries which are essential and require investment on a massive scale (which only the State could provide) have also to be in the public sector. Thus, the State has to assume direct responsibility for the future development of industries."

This Resolution classifies industries into three categories:
• The first category given in Schedule A consists of industries, the future development of which will be the exclusive responsibility of the State.
• The second category, given in Schedule B, includes industries which will be progressively State-owned. However, private enterprise will also be expected to participate in them.
• The third category comprises all the remaining industries, the further development of which will be left to the initiative and enterprise of the private sector.
questions.instruction_line: दिए गए गद्य तथा सामान्य समझ के आधार पर, निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए:
questions.instruction_line_english: On the basis of the given text and common understanding, answer the following questions :

sub_questions.text: "भारत सरकार ने, आर्थिक विकास के प्रारंभिक वर्षों में औद्योगिक विकास में सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र के लिए बड़ी भूमिका पर बल दिया था।" अपने उत्तर के समर्थन में कारण देते हुए, इस कथन की पुष्टि कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: "The Government of India, in the initial years of economic development, emphasized a greater role for the public sector in industrial development." Justify the statement, giving reasons in support of your answer.

key_points: Goal was socialist pattern of development.
State needed to manage basic/strategic industries due to lack of private capital and the need for planned rapid growth.

sub_questions.solution: The government emphasized a dominant public sector to promote a socialist pattern of economy and ensure rapid, planned growth. Given the lack of sufficient private capital for large-scale investments in basic and strategic industries, the state had to take direct responsibility for these sectors to ensure stability and national interest.

sub_questions.text: औद्योगिक नीति संकल्प, 1956 के अनुसार विभिन्न श्रेणियों में उद्योगों के वर्गीकरण की रूपरेखा प्रस्तुत कीजिए और चर्चा कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: Outline and discuss the classification of industries into various categories as per Industrial Policy Resolution, 1956.

key_points: Schedule A: Exclusive state responsibility.
Schedule B: Progressively state-owned, with some private participation.
Third Category: Private sector-led development.

sub_questions.solution: The IPR 1956 classified industries into three categories: Schedule A industries, which were the exclusive responsibility of the State; Schedule B industries, which were to be progressively state-owned but allowed for some private sector participation; and a third category encompassing all remaining industries, the development of which was left to the private sector's initiative.

questions.solution: The IPR 1956 aimed to establish a socialist structure and rapid growth, necessitating state control over vital industries. The classification strategy balanced state and private roles.
